about_the_game:
We are continuously developing and optimizing more content, and at the same time, we truly hope to hear your voice.

What kind of hidden scenes would you like to discover in the “Prairie Sanctuary”?
What exciting mechanics do you want to see in future boss battles?
What are your thoughts or predictions about the storyline of Thunder-Eye?

If you have any ideas, suggestions, or inspiration, share your thoughts with us directly! Every piece of feedback you provide will be carefully considered, discussed, and may even be directly incorporated into the future development plans of the game.

We believe that the best version of Thunder-Eye will be created together—by us and by you!

▌Command the Deadly Swarm: From Recon to Annihilation – Your Drone Arsenal Awaits

You will take direct control of a complete and lethal drone system, embodying the modern warfare doctrine of "see it, destroy it":

● Suicide FPV Drones: Become a battlefield daredevil. Dive first-person into targets and execute the ultimate art of one-shot, one-kill.

● Recon Drones: Hear thunder in the silence. Hover above the enemy and deliver precise, devastating judgment from above.

● RPG-Launching Drones: Elevate infantry firepower. Deploy a mobile artillery unit suspended in the skies.

From behind-enemy-lines reconnaissance to precision strikes, you are the pivotal link in the mission chain—orchestrating a symphony of steel and fire with every drone at your command.

▌Multi-Dimensional Battlefield Storm: Dominate All Fronts

Your hit list spans the entire combat zone: Obliterate impregnable main battle tanks, hunt down patrolling naval vessels, eliminate high-value enemy infantry, and even challenge enemy jets for air superiority. Whether it's fortified structures or mobile units, nothing will survive the multi-axis storm of destruction you unleash.

▌Immersive Warzone Narrative: Live the Headlines

Beyond realistic battlegrounds—from tense village ruins and dense concealment forests to complex industrial facilities—you are no longer a spectator. You are on the ground, immersed in high-stakes missions at the heart of modern conflict. Experience the brutal, true face of drone warfare.

▌Hardcore Operational Challenge: Survive by Skill Alone

Each mission is a full-scale military operation. From simple target confirmation to complex multi-phase assaults, enemy fire will saturate the air, and terrain will be your only ally. Whether executing precision strikes or advancing on multiple fronts, every task pushes your limits—only razor-sharp precision and ice-cold tactical thinking will let you dance on the edge and dominate the battlefield.

Future Update Plans – We hope they ignite your excitement:

🌿 New Map: Prairie Sanctuary
Soar across boundless grasslands and delve into forgotten natural realms. Complex terrain and shifting wind currents will offer unprecedented flight challenges and visual delight.

⚓ Deep Sea Warship Boss Battle
A steel giant stands towering over the open ocean. This is an aerial assault that tests both strategy and skill—break through its layered defenses and conquer the master of the seas.

🛡️ Armored Siege Boss Battle
Face a heavily fortified land fortress. Navigate through crossfires, target weak points, and dismantle its defenses layer by layer.

🦅 Aerial Iron Hawk Boss Battle
Engage in high-speed aerial combat against elite enemy drone formations in the clouds. Extreme agility and intense firepower will put your control and reflexes to the ultimate test.

🚗 NPC System Upgrade
The world will feel more alive! We’re adding more diverse characters and vehicle units that will play various roles on the battlefield, making every mission more dynamic and realistic.

🎞️ Story CG Cutscenes
High-quality cinematic animations will be added at key mission points, unveiling the story behind Thunder-Eye with enhanced tension and immersion.

Sincerely,
The Thunder-Eye Development Team

  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: MVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

Recommended:

  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10

  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Thunder's Eye is a war sim about drone combat. You are a drone pilot in a war‑torn world, flying through jungles and islands. Use different drones for attack and defense missions. Every target tests your skill and courage in the brutal reality of war.
